description: This file defines a Java Servlet Filter named ContentUrlFilter, which intercepts HTTP requests to handle specific content URL patterns. It processes URLs ending with '-content', retrieves relevant content data from the database, and forwards the request to a constructed URL if appropriate. Otherwise, it performs alias checking or passes the request along the filter chain.

classes.name: ContentUrlFilter
classes.description: A Java Servlet Filter that processes content-related URL patterns to retrieve and forward content data.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter with configuration parameters.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Main filter method that processes incoming requests, handles URLs ending with '-content', retrieves content data, and forwards or continues the filter chain.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Performs cleanup when the filter is destroyed.
